exit_criterion.command: ./node_modules/.bin/nx test frontend --testNamePattern='refetches the readiness the cache still considers fresh'

$comment_why_behavioural: D-068: asserting that the options object contains `refetchOnMount: 'always'` would be configuration asserting itself and would pass without the defect ever having been real. The criterion drives two mounts against a QueryClient carrying the app's real ten-minute staleTime and asserts the gateway was called twice — which fails on today's code.
